text.en:
However, In the interest of the service,
heads of departments, bureaus, offices, agencies
and Instrumentalities of the Government, including
the provincial and municipal governments and all
corporations owned or controlled by the Government,
are enjoined to require at least one half of their
personnel to be on duty in the afternoon.
leads of government agencies and/or offices
involved in the implementation of the Administra-
tion's crash rice program and public works cons-
truction projects shall make proper and necessary
arrangements and/or adjustments in their respective
jurisdictions of their office hours with a view
to utilizing available manpower services without
detriment to the deadlines and time schedules of
the said program and projects, provided that the
five-hour office schedule herein set shall not in
any daso be reduced.
Done in the City of Manile, this 22nd day of
in the year of our lord, nineteen hundred
and sixty-nine.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Fhilippines
By the Fresident:
(SGD.) RAFAEL M. SALAS
Executive Secretary
